pageSubtitle: The mind and technology shaping the industrial future.
cultureTitle: Mind and Technology Shaping the Industrial Future
cultureDesc1: Siskon is an independent engineering firm operating in industrial software, automation, and data analytics, developing its own technology with innovative solutions. From process automation to industrial internet of things, high-level traceability solutions to AI-based data systems, we make production processes more efficient, traceable, and smart. Along with our headquarters in Turkey, we operate on an international scale with our offices in Romania and Estonia.
cultureDesc2: SINCE 1997, we have been leading the digital transformation in the automotive, home appliances, food, textile, tobacco, and machinery sectors.
highlight1Text: With our own algorithms, in-house developed hardware and globally executed projects, we place software at the center of industrial intelligence. Today, Siskon-signed solutions operate in dozens of countries, across many sectors, in hundreds of systems worldwide.
highlight2Title: From Founders' Vision to Young Minds
highlight2Text: Siskon is more than a classic engineering company. We combine the seriousness of experience with the agility and openness to change of younger generations. We hear every idea, evaluate every data point, and share every success.
highlight3Text: Developing technology alone is not easy. That's why Siskon is a collective engineering team rather than just an institution. Experts from different disciplines, from software architects to data scientists, hardware specialists to young engineers, work with the same vision.
highlight4Title: Beyond Solution Partners, We Are Value Partners
highlight4Text: We take ownership of our business partners' goals as our own; we go beyond being a solution partner and establish value partnerships. For sustainable success, we stand by your side in every project with shared vision, trust and engineering excellence.
visionText: To become a globally recognized world brand with high export power, producing innovative solutions in the industrial software and automation sector; to be the most trusted solution partner in our customers' digital transformation processes with our sectoral expertise.
missionText: To increase the global competitiveness of enterprises with innovative, reliable and sustainable solutions in all processes from production to management in the industry's digital transformation journey.
ctaSectionTitle: Let's advance your corporate vision together
ctaSectionDesc: Contact us for detailed information about our corporate culture, engineering approach and working model.
